title: в лесу, на берегу: the stressed -у

blocks.text: Some masculine nouns take the ending -у (always with a stress) in the prepositional-locative case, i.e. after the prepositions в or на. The same nouns have the regular ending -е after о, об. *Я был в лесу, в саду, в аэропорту, на берегу.* Also: на мосту, в полку, в or на снегу. However: *Я говорю о лесе, об аэропорте.*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 27.

The exercises are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. The word in brackets is the dictionary form of the missing word.
